component.name: PlasmaZones Settings
component.summary: Configure window snapping, tiling and scrolling

description.p: The PlasmaZones Settings app is the standalone configuration surface for the PlasmaZones window placement system on KDE Plasma. PlasmaZones gives every monitor one of three placement modes. Snapping drops windows into zones you drew, tiling places them automatically with a scripted algorithm, and scrolling arranges them as columns on an endless strip.

Most options also appear inside System Settings via the KCM. The standalone app is the place to live-tune animations and shaders with previews, manage per-app rules, and review the daemon's runtime state.

ul.li: Snap behaviour (modifiers, drag delays, zone span, overlay timing)
Scrolling columns, tabs, tab indicators, and strip templates
Which mode each monitor, desktop, and activity uses
Animations, shader effects, and per-event motion profiles
Window decoration packs and zone overlay appearance
